mapper.insert: INSERT INTO invite_project_grant (invite_id, workspace_id, project_id, access) VALUES (#{inviteId}, #{workspaceId}, #{projectId}, #{access}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE access = VALUES(access)
mapper.select: SELECT invite_id, workspace_id, project_id, access, created_at FROM invite_project_grant WHERE invite_id = #{inviteId} ORDER BY project_id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM invite_project_grant WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND project_id = #{projectId}
